submission.reason: Exploration of data/explore.csv showed rainfall_mm was the only exposure with a strong, robust association with species_richness after accounting for region (full model: coef=0.48, t=3.77, p=0.00019; all other exposures non-significant except marginal nitrate p=0.039). The pre-registered confirmatory OLS on held-out data (outcome ~ rainfall_mm + region indicators) confirmed a significant positive direct effect: estimate=0.450, SE=0.129, t=3.48, p=0.00055, n=396, alpha=0.05.
